title: Fractured-lands
description: A Worldgen type for a Xianxia fantasy look on minecraft
body:
![Fracturedlands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d705ba0d81957e40b85549778a5d6e76f5aedfc8.png)

This mod is part of another project I've been working on, but I decided to make it separate so you can use and enjoy it too. I created this worldgen to try and give the world a more fantastical feel, but with a bit of organized chaos. Noise creates beautiful landscapes and also great locations for base camps and exploration, besides modifying both underground with large caves, it also makes the overworld more magical in my opinion hehe. I hope you like it, I don't know if there will be an update :)
